verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly publish a programmatic API, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes interactive web surfaces: Online Services accounts, Web File, Quick Pay and online calculators. The mention of 'approved software' for filing points to third-party vendor products, not a documented public API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec at common paths all returned 404, and the /e-services/ transaction paths are robots-disallowed for all agents. Neither finding is a documented API, so no credit is earned.
